kurals.tr: Selvaththut Selvanj Chevichchelvam Achchelvam / Selvaththu Lellaan Thalai
kurals.m: Wealth (gained) by the ear is wealth of wealth; that wealth is the chief of all wealth

kurals.tr: Sevikkuna Villaadha Pozhdhu Siridhu / Vayitrukkum Eeyap Patum
kurals.m: When there is no food for the ear, give a little also to the stomach

kurals.tr: Seviyunavir Kelvi Yutaiyaar Aviyunavin / Aandraaro Toppar Nilaththu
kurals.m: Those who in this world enjoy instruction which is the food of the ear, are equal to the Gods, who enjoy the food of the sacrifices

kurals.tr: Katrila Naayinung Ketka Aqdhoruvarku / Orkaththin Ootraan Thunai
kurals.m: Although a man be without learning, let him listen (to the teaching of the learned); that will be to him a staff in adversity

kurals.tr: Izhukkal Utaiyuzhi Ootrukkol Atre / Ozhukka Mutaiyaarvaaich Chol
kurals.m: The words of the good are like a staff in a slippery place

kurals.tr: Enaiththaanum Nallavai Ketka Anaiththaanum / Aandra Perumai Tharum
kurals.m: Let a man listen, never so little, to good (instruction), even that will bring him great dignity

kurals.tr: Pizhaith Thunarndhum Pedhaimai Sollaa / Rizhaiththunarn Theentiya Kelvi Yavar
kurals.m: Not even when they have imperfectly understood (a matter), will those men speak foolishly, who have profoundly studied and diligently listened (to instruction)

kurals.tr: Ketpinung Kelaath Thakaiyave Kelviyaal / Thotkap Pataadha Sevi
kurals.m: The ear which has not been bored by instruction, although it hears, is deaf

kurals.tr: Nunangiya Kelviya Rallaar Vanangiya / Vaayina Raadhal Aridhu
kurals.m: It is a rare thing to find modesty, a reverend mouth- with those who have not received choice instruction

kurals.tr: Seviyir Suvaiyunaraa Vaayunarvin Maakkal / Aviyinum Vaazhinum En?
kurals.m: What does it matter whether those men live or die, who can judge of tastes by the mouth, and not by the ear ?
